Subject: Your consumer complaint matter - CC/2946/2022

Dear Ms. More,

Thank you for meeting us on 20/02/2023 about your dispute with M/s Mehra Developers. As we understand it, the flat was handed over with serious construction defects. The matter is listed before the Warangal District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission.

Our advice is to commission a structural audit report on the defects before the first hearing. Please collect photographs of the defects and a structural audit report and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs 54,40,000.

Regards,
Adv. Hema Lakshmanan

spans.text: Warangal District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
